checks.explanation: Palantir shorts have lost heavily since this November 2025 episode: an August 2026 earnings-driven 30% single-day rally alone wiped out roughly $3B in short-seller paper gains, with short interest sitting on an estimated $5B in mark-to-market losses that month.

sources.title: Palantir short sellers sustain $3B loss following stock's 30% rally
